questions.prompt: In which quadrant does \(\theta\) lie if \(\sin\theta\) is positive and \(\cos\theta\) is positive?
questions.explanation: Use the ASTC rule (All, Sine, Tangent, Cosine). The only quadrant with these two signs is quadrant I.
